answer: Entrance exams make every fake key sit its own test. A new key draws 3 questions from a nadir pool of 600, each with 4 choices, and needs all 3 right to join. Each failed attempt burns 8 POA, and a key crossing 2 failures in one epoch is locked out until the ripple of the next epoch begins. A blind guesser passes 1 in 64, so each fake burns 63 x 8 = 504 POA on average. 100 yarrow fakes x 504 POA = 50,400 POA the attacker forfeits.
